title: Seeded defect and proof-carrying review
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for mutation-guided reviewer calibration across six seeded defect classes, proof-carrying refusal and approval verification and exact Wilson score plus paired bootstrap confidence intervals.
boundaries: SeededDefectMutantSuite injects six deterministic defect classes (digest_mismatch, boundary_off_by_one, silent_exception_swallow, capability_tier_violation, self_approval_principal_reuse and ungrounded_citation_span) into candidate bundles.
ProofCarryingReviewVerifier enforces no refusal without a reproducible failing check and witness, and no approval unless reviewer mutant kill rate meets the grid threshold.
StatisticalIntervalAuditor computes exact Wilson score intervals and seeded paired bootstrap confidence intervals from default_grid_spec.json bounds without inline magic numbers.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for mutation-guided reviewer calibration across six seeded defect classes, proof-carrying refusal and approval verification and exact Wilson score plus paired bootstrap confidence intervals

value.lets_workers: Calibrate reviewers against clean-vs-mutant bundle twins across six universal defect classes, reject unfounded refusals that lack a reproducible failing check witness, reject rubber-stamp approvals below mutant kill thresholds and bound pass/kill rates and system deltas with Wilson score and paired bootstrap confidence intervals.

flow.when: Synthesize deterministic seeded-defect twins across six universal failure classes from clean candidate bundles.
Calibrate reviewer sensitivity and specificity on clean-vs-mutant twins and reject unfounded refusals or rubber-stamp approvals.
Independently compute Wilson score and paired bootstrap confidence intervals and verify ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate conformance.

value.worked_example: Two clean candidate bundles expanded into 12 seeded-defect mutants across all 6 defect classes, calibrating a proof-carrying reviewer (1.0 kill rate, Wilson 95% CI [0.7575, 1.0], 0.0 clean FPR), rejecting unfounded refusals and rubber-stamp approvals and computing a paired bootstrap CI [0.215, 0.2263] in test_proof_carrying_review.py.

nouns.title: Guardrail: review refusals must cite at least one reproducible failing check ID and matching witness
nouns.category_reason: Eliminates hallucinated, nitpicky or ungrounded reviewer blocks on clean candidate artifacts.

value.rule: ProofCarryingReviewVerifier rejects any review refusal that fails to name an actual failing deterministic check_id and witness reproduced against the candidate bundle.
value.how_it_is_checked: ProofCarryingReviewVerifier.verify_review_decision re-executes SeededDefectMutantSuite.run_checks and rejects empty or non-reproducing refusal claims.

nouns.title: Guardrail: review approvals require calibrated mutant kill rates and zero inline magic literals
nouns.category_reason: Prevents rubber-stamp approvals and ensures statistical confidence parameters resolve strictly from default_grid_spec.json.

value.rule: ProofCarryingReviewVerifier rejects approvals when underlying deterministic checks fail or when reviewer mutant_kill_rate falls below min_mutant_kill_rate in default_grid_spec.json, and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate rejects inline magic numbers.
value.how_it_is_checked: test_proof_carrying_review.py verifies rubber-stamp rejection, 6-class mutant detection, exact Wilson/bootstrap intervals and zero AST magic-literal violations.
